name: openthai2.0-legal-thaillm-nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni-30B-A3B-Reasoning-BF16 (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni-30B-A3B-Reasoning-BF16: 0 full GQA layers (kv heads 1, head_dim None) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A Thai-law SFT of nvidia/Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni-30B-A3B-Reasoning-BF16 (SFT then GRPO on NitiBench citation F1). The base is an omni model; this repo is text-only, architecture NemotronHForCausalLM against the base's NemotronH_Nano_Omni_Reasoning_V3, and 31.578B of safetensors against the base's 33.016B - the delta is the audio/vision towers, not a smaller language model. The base's own record still carries the 30.0 from its name; this one carries the measured count. Recorded because the card prints a three-column table (this model, Qwen3.6-35B, Nemotron-3-30B base) across 10 axes and it wins every one against the base, most of them by a wide margin - closed-book Civil & Commercial recall 0.07 vs 0.001 is the sharpest. Caveat: essay rows are graded by Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite, and the closed-book Tax row (0.40 vs 0.31, n=50) is a small sample. Licence nvidia-open-model-agreement, repo created 2026-07-17.
